trips.label: Christchurch in a Day
trips.description: The central city on foot: the Botanic Gardens, a punt on the Avon, lunch at Little High, a ride on the tram, the Art Gallery and an evening walk by the river.

trips.label: Two Days in Christchurch
trips.description: Day one in the central city on foot. Day two by car: the gondola, pizza at Sumner and the clifftop walk to Taylors Mistake, then fish and chips and the hot pools at New Brighton.

trips.label: Queenstown in Two Days
trips.description: Day one in town: the gardens, an early Fergburger, a cruise on the Earnslaw, then the gondola and luge. Day two: the Shotover Jet and the Kawarau bungy bridge, then lunch, gold panning and the Chinese settlement in Arrowtown.

items.siteName: Lakes District Museum and Gold Panning

trips.label: Queenstown in Three Days
trips.description: Day one in town and day two in Arrowtown, as in the two-day trip. Day three up the lake: Bob's Cove, the Glenorchy wharf, lunch at Mrs Woolly's and the lagoon walk, then the waterfront and fish and chips back in town.

items.siteName: Lakes District Museum and Gold Panning

trips.label: Queenstown and Fiordland in Three Days
trips.description: Day one: the gondola and Fergburger, then the drive to Te Anau and the glowworm caves. Day two: Milford Sound by road, with Mirror Lakes and Lake Gunn on the way, a cruise and dinner at Redcliff back in Te Anau. Day three: the Kepler Track to Brod Bay, then back to Queenstown for the gardens and dinner at The Cow.

trips.label: Queenstown and Fiordland in Five Days
trips.description: Days one and two as in the three-day trip: the drive to Te Anau, the glowworm caves and Milford Sound. Day three on Doubtful Sound from Manapōuri. Day four up to Key Summit, then the bird sanctuary and Frasers Beach. Day five on the Kepler Track, then back to Queenstown for the gardens and dinner at The Cow.

trips.label: Queenstown and Wānaka in Four Days
trips.description: Day one in Queenstown. Day two: the Shotover Jet and Arrowtown, then over the Crown Range to Cardrona and Wānaka. Day three in Wānaka: Diamond Lake and Rocky Mountain, and a paddle on the lake. Day four: Mount Iron, fruit at Cromwell and the Kawarau bungy bridge on the way back.

items.siteName: Diamond Lake and Rocky Mountain Track

trips.label: Christchurch to Queenstown via Tekapo and Mount Cook
trips.description: Day one inland to Tekapo, with pies at Fairlie, the hot pools and stargazing on Mt John. Day two: the Church of the Good Shepherd and Mt John, then Mount Cook and Kea Point. Day three: the Hooker Valley first thing, salmon at Lake Pukaki and over the Lindis Pass to Wānaka. Day four through Cromwell and the Kawarau Gorge to Queenstown.

items.siteName: Mt John Summit and Astro Café
Tasman Glacier View and Blue Lakes

trips.label: Queenstown to Christchurch via Mount Cook and Tekapo
trips.description: Day one over the Crown Range to Wānaka, with the Shotover Jet and Arrowtown on the way. Day two over the Lindis Pass to Mount Cook, with salmon at Lake Pukaki. Day three on the Hooker Valley Track first thing, then Mt John, the hot pools and stargazing at Tekapo. Day four past the Church of the Good Shepherd and through Geraldine to Christchurch.

items.siteName: Tasman Glacier View and Blue Lakes
Mt John Summit and Astro Café

trips.label: Picton to Christchurch via Kaikōura
trips.description: Day one off the ferry: the Edwin Fox and the Snout Track in Picton, then down the coast past the seals, with crayfish at Nin's Bin, to dinner at the Pier Hotel. Day two whale watching, crayfish for lunch and the peninsula walk. Day three inland to the hot pools at Hanmer Springs, then on to Christchurch.

items.siteName: Kaikōura Peninsula Walkway and Seal Colony

trips.label: Southern Scenic Route: Queenstown to Dunedin
trips.description: Days one and two in Fiordland: the glowworm caves and Milford Sound. Day three along the south coast through Tuatapere and Riverton to Invercargill. Day four out to Bluff, then the Catlins: Waipapa Point, Curio Bay and McLean Falls. Day five past Nugget Point to Dunedin's Tunnel Beach and St Clair. Day six in Dunedin and on the Otago Peninsula.

trips.label: South Island in 7 Days
trips.description: Christchurch to Queenstown by the West Coast. Day one over Arthur's Pass to Greymouth. Day two at Punakaiki's Pancake Rocks, then on to Hokitika. Day three: Hokitika Gorge and the treetop walk, a scenic flight from Whataroa, then the hot pools at Franz Josef. Day four: the glacier valley and Ōkārito, then Fox. Day five: Lake Matheson and down the coast to Haast. Day six over the Haast Pass to Wānaka. Day seven through Cromwell to Queenstown.

trips.label: South Island in 7 Days
